verdict.rationale: Wise's card APIs support creating multiple business cards and setting spend controls (MCC, currency, transaction type restrictions) which finance teams can use to limit how cards are used, but there is no documented feature for defining department/program-level budgets with automatically enforced aggregate spend limits — only per-card transaction rules. Missing for 10: explicit budget object/limit enforcement per department or program, reporting tied to budget vs actual spend, and any UI/API for setting a numeric spend cap that blocks transactions once exceeded.
